inputs.proposal: Inline the failure backoff step in the J2534 worker: drop j2534_backoff.h and double backoff_ms in place in all three worker modes, capped at J2534_BACKOFF_CAP_MS.

blockers:
claim: The inlined backoff logic has a different condition than the original function, failing to clamp the doubled value to the cap. The original returns cap when ms >= 2500, but the new code returns ms*2 when ms < 5000, which can exceed the cap (e.g., ms=3000 yields 6000 instead of 5000).; file: core/src/j2534_transport.cpp; quote: backoff_ms = (backoff_ms < J2534_BACKOFF_CAP_MS)
                      ? backoff_ms * 2 : J2534_BACKOFF_CAP_MS;
nits: The header comment states 'The doubled value is what gets clamped, so no wait exceeds the cap even though the cap isn't the base times a power of two' — this invariant is broken by the new code.
Consider using std::min(backoff_ms * 2, J2534_BACKOFF_CAP_MS) for clearer intent and to prevent this class of error.
